title: Checkpoints
description: <port>/state/checkpoints.json: every step completed on this port, oldest first.

format_version.description: Version of this file's format. Readers refuse any value other than 1.

checkpoints.description: Completed steps in the order they finished.

step.description: Name of the step, such as "start" or "prepare_environment".

completed_at.description: When the step finished, ISO 8601 in UTC.
